data.title: PR 18: program-level replay oracle for atom deletion and RFC 0028 minimizer transcripts

data.reason: risk:high audit. Failure modes: false minimality, non-program candidates, transcript exhaustion, oracle ambiguity, and resource exhaustion. Edge cases: empty and one-event cores, partial groups, skipped actor operations, memo hits, and UTF-8 reason truncation. Rollback: revert the two reviewed commits and retain the prior substrate/configuration reducer without program-atom claims. Monitoring: watch omitted attempts, typed pass endings, and program refusal/divergence counts. Validation: reviewed 49d65d7f..a6c2363c; 18 debugger tests and 21 program-replay tests passed, including the 400-run corpus and golden artifacts. The full gate reached only unrelated sandbox keystore failures because root reported uid 65534. No security blocker.
